summary: @btopro It is for this same reason I believe in microformats as my favorite type of metadata. Carrying metadata in the class attribute of any HTML element makes the most logical sense. most resilient and actually (beyond maybe Open Graph) the most socially used.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @btopro It is for this same reason I believe in microformats as my favorite type of metadata. Carrying metadata in the class attribute of any HTML element makes the most logical sense. most resilient and actually (beyond maybe Open Graph) the most socially used.
